data.name: Rahid
data.gender_notes: Rahid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: He who sets free, or releases, or emancipates. The name Rahid carries the meaning “Liberator, Free” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rahid usually hope their child will grow to embody liberator, free and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Someone who frees the soul from the shackles of ignorance, hatred, and fear
data.etymology: Rahid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Liberator, Free.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rahid total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: راحد
in_arabic.meaning: من السهل والمريح للمسافرين أو المحاربين أو المسلمين
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رحيد مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ر-ح-د' والذي يدل على الراحة والسهولة، ويرتبط بالسكن والاطمئنان. يستخدم هذا الاسم في سياق التعبير عن الراحة والهدوء في الحياة، خاصةً للمسافرين أو المحاربين أو المسلمين الذين يسعون للراحة والسكينة.

in_urdu.name: راحد
in_urdu.meaning: مسافرین یا محاربین یا مسلمانوں کے لئے آرام دہ اور مريح
in_urdu.long_meaning: راحید نام عربی جڑ 'ر-ح-د' سے نکلا ہے، جو راحت اور آسانی کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، اور سکن اور اطمینان سے منسلک ہے۔ یہ نام زندگی میں راحت اور سکون کے حصول کے سلسلے میں استعمال ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر مسافرین یا محاربین یا مسلمانوں کے لئے جو راحت اور سکینہ کی تلاش میں ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: راحد
in_hindi.meaning: यात्रियों या योद्धाओं या मुसलमानों के लिए आरामदायक और सुविधाजनक
in_hindi.long_meaning: راحید नाम की उत्पत्ति 'र-ح-د' अरबी मूल से हुई है, जो आराम और सुगमता की ओर संकेत करता है, और शांति और संतोष से जुड़ा हुआ है। यह नाम जीवन में आराम और शांति प्राप्त करने के संदर्भ में प्रयोग किया जाता है, विशेष रूप से यात्रियों या योद्धाओं या मुसलमानों के लिए जो आराम और शांति की तलाश में हैं।

in_pashto.name: راحد
in_pashto.meaning: د مسافرو لپاره د ارام او مريح
in_pashto.long_meaning: د رحيد نوم عربي ريښو 'ر-ح-د' څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې د ارام او اسانۍ ښودنه کوي، او د سولې او ارام سره تړلی دی. دا نوم د ژوند په ارام او سکون کې د ترلاسه کولو لپاره کارول کیږي، په ځانګړي ډول د مسافرو يا محاربينو يا مسلمانانو لپاره چې د ارام او سکون په لټه کې دي.

in_english.name: Rahid
in_english.meaning: Comforting, soothing, and peaceful for travelers, warriors, or Muslims
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rahid originates from the Arabic root 'ر-ح-د' (R-H-D), which signifies comfort, ease, and tranquility. It is associated with peacefulness and serenity. In Islamic tradition, this name is used to express a desire for comfort and peace, particularly for travelers, warriors, or Muslims seeking solace and calmness in life. The name Rahid reflects qualities of being soothing, calming, and reassuring, embodying a sense of security and stability.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rahid, meaning "He who sets free", is deeply rooted in Islamic tradition and cultural significance. In Islamic texts, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is known to have given or promised the freedom of slaves during the pilgrimage to Mecca. Moreover, the concept of 'release or emancipation' also extends to the spiritual and moral freedom that comes with practicing the religion and following its teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name Rahid holds immense significance. A Rahid, in an Islamic context, represents a person who has suddenly been freed from the chains of ignorance, cruelty, or sin. This transformation is seen both internally, as the individual gains higher knowledge, understanding, and inner peace, and externally, as the person becomes more compassionate and strives to uplift the suffering of others. This name is a constant reminder of the transformative power of faith upon an individual's life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Liberator, Free" symbolizes He who sets free, or releases, or emancipates. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rahid serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of liberator, free.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Rahid was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is mentioned in various Hadiths. The name Rahid carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Rahid remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
